chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: The band's names: Quality Serenaders and the Blackbirds
summary: Willard asks when the group became the Quality Serenaders and the Blackbirds; Howard cannot give years but confirms they recorded in the 1920s.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: At what point did you name your band? Your band was known as Paul Howard's Quality Serenaders.
Paul Howard's Quality Serenaders, and before that I (Inaudible) the Blackbirds. Yeah.
I can hold it for you.
In what year -- do you remember what year it became known as the Blackbirds?
No, I don't remember what year. But it wasn't none of these years way down in here now.

The Quality Serenaders, according to this book by Albert McCarthy, that was the name of your band during the '20s, but I don't know exactly when. It mentions that you recorded, though, in the '20s. Is that right?
It said, I believe, the first time was with the Black and Tan Orchestra.
That's it. Had to get the Black and Tan in there some kind of way.
